messages.content: What documents do I need to prepare for a home loan application?

To apply for a home loan, you will need to prepare the following documents:

**Documents required for Home Loan:**
- **Identity proof:** Aadhaar card + PAN card (mandatory)
- **Address proof:** Utility bill, bank statement, or rental agreement
- **Income proof:** Last 3 months pay slips / last 2 years audited financials
- **Bank statements:** Last 12 months bank statements (for salaried applicants) / 24 months (for self-employed applicants)
- **Form 16:** For the last 2 years (salaried applicants)
- **Property documents:** Sale agreement or allotment letter
- **Title documents:** Title deed and chain of title documents
- **Building approvals:** Approved building plan and NOC from builder or housing society
- **Tax receipts:** Property tax receipts (latest)

Make sure to gather all these documents to ensure a smooth application process. If you have any further questions, feel free to ask!
